key.name: auto-location
key.description: Use IP-based location detection instead of a manual place

key.name: show-icon
key.summary: Show the animated icon in the panel

key.name: animate
key.description: When off, the icon renders a single static frame

key.name: provider
key.description: Both providers are keyless and free. open-meteo = Open-Meteo global forecast (default); met-norway = Norwegian Meteorological Institute locationforecast, CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution (reports precipitation amounts, not probabilities, so the precipitation chart is model-derived)

key.name: show-hourly
key.summary: Hourly condition icons on the chart
key.description: Small sun / moon / cloud / rain icons along the top of the hourly chart, aligned with the time axis; past hours fade with the curve

key.name: menu-style
key.description: animated = translucent weather sky, solid = the sky dimmed under a wash, accent = no sky: the shell theme's own popup background with the charts drawn in the OS accent colour

key.name: preview-scene
key.summary: Temporarily preview an animation on the panel icon
key.description: Set by the preferences window; the extension clears it back to empty when the preview ends

key.name: windy-threshold
key.summary: Wind speed (km/h) that triggers the wind animation
